project_info.name: Digital Care AI - SaaS High-Ticket Dental Dashboard
project_info.target_audience: Italian High-Ticket Dental Clinics (Studio Dentistico Bellini)
project_info.aesthetic: Awwwards-Level Luxury Cybernetic Dark Mode, Neon Cyan/Aqua accents, Glassmorphic Frosted Surfaces, High Tech Precision
project_info.tech_stack: React js (.js / .jsx), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide React Icons, Canvas/Glass styling

visual_enhancers.ai_status_ping: relative flex h-3 w-3 inline-flex rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping opacity-75
visual_enhancers.smartphone_chat_sim: rounded-[40px] border-4 border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,245,212,0.15)] relative overflow-hidden
visual_enhancers.roi_value_neon: text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-black bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 via-cyan-400 to-teal-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,245,212,0.5)]

layout_structure.sidebar: Fixed narrow left navigation (Width 80px - expanded 240px on hover/toggle) with links: Dashboard, Calendario, Chat & Pazienti, Analitiche, Impostazioni AI
layout_structure.topbar: Sticky header with Logo 'Digital Care AI' + Clinic Switcher 'Studio Dentistico Bellini', AI Status Pill ('AI ATTIVA 24/7 - In ascolto'), Notification Bell with live count, and User Profile ('Dr. Marco Bellini')
layout_structure.hero_metrics: Grid of 4 ROI Cards (Appuntamenti Fissati dall'AI: 48 [+12%], Disdette Recuperate: 14, Ore Segreteria Risparmiate: 56h, Valore Generato Stimato: €3.200 in neon green)
layout_structure.main_grid: Grid with 70% left column (Agenda Live table + Waitlist with 'Fai chiamare dall'AI' action) and 30% right column (Live AI Simulated Chat on Smartphone frame + Big Glowing Emergency TAKEOVER button)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Implementation must use React JavaScript files (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx) files.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, tables, badges) contain exact data-testid attributes.
Build a stunning glassmorphic ultra-dark UI (#080C14 background) with glowing neon cyan/aqua accents (#00F5D4, #00E5FF) and emerald positive ROI highlights (#00FF87).
Implement the typewriter animation for the Live AI Chat simulated smartphone dialogue and real-time pulse indicator for the 24/7 AI listener status.
Add full interactive functionality for the 'TAKEOVER: Intervieni e blocca l'AI' button with a dramatic emergency modal/banner confirmation.
Add 'Fai chiamare dall'AI' automated outbound call simulation with status toast/modal feedback when clicked.
